title: SUNPEED Victory Expert test ride
notes: Independent exact-model test identifies Toray T800 with T1000 reinforcement, Shimano 105 Di2 and a measured 8.1 kg for the tested L bike. The tester reports responsive standing/sprint behavior, a solid BB/headset feel, a stiff cockpit and unexpectedly smooth comfort. No numeric stiffness value or verified maximum tire clearance is supplied.
